title: r07 HOME · jaw and eye study, unfinished
question: Does refining the HOME-derived head improve its jaw and eye read?
controls: Existing PokeAPI-hosted HOME sprite baseline chosen by Kevin; no new generation
Same isolated head frame, four cameras, gray material and Workbench lighting
Frozen raw source and failed intermediate trials preserved

changedFactors.name: jaw
changedFactors.to: Aligned35% depth reduction plus native Smooth

changedFactors.name: eyes
changedFactors.to: Two closed fitted patches with provisional white/teal/black material bands

changedFactors.name: lids
changedFactors.to: Fitted bands, MANIFOLD union, native Smooth, paired tessellation-flap removal

recipe.model: Blender MCP geometry fitting/Boolean; native GUI sculpt; reopened static GLB

evaluation.notes: Shallower jaw and visible eyes improve local readability. Muzzle remains bulbous, horns tubular/asymmetric, iris bands too crude, and eyelid edges uneven. Technical round-trip passes; likeness and complete-asset quality do not.
